provenance.name: Synthetic keyboard-noise typo corpus

vocab_cut.rule: corrections sampled from the rank-ordered dictionary-vocab intersection

provenance.admission_rule: correction is an un-flagged pure-letter dictionary stem inside the model vocabulary; typo is not a dictionary word and is reachable by the declared noise ops
provenance.caveat: generator-domain evidence: the plan-114 bi-encoder trained on the same noise model, so this corpus never replaces the frozen real components
provenance.license: generated data; dictionary licenses per the dictionaries repository
